RVQ_statistics_reuse.note: All RVQ values and physical GT spans reused unchanged; new K256 metrics/usage recomputed on identical nodes.

definitions.cohort: K256 usage over all verified retained K256 outputs; RVQ usage over accepted RVQ non-STOP macro nodes; performance on paired complete trajectories only.
definitions.metric_weighting: per-trajectory metrics; N/mean/P50/P95; route strata are paired-cohort path-length tertiles.
definitions.comparability: Full open-loop, locally re-anchored H5, and global heading drift are separate; no policy or robot inference.
definitions.sampling: Both branches share identical real macro observation nodes; K256 executes one decoded macro action, RVQ executes decoded[0]; valid H5 future nodes share the current origin.

codebook.normalization: stored weighted mean/scale; decoded macro centers are forward m,left m,CCW rad

training_contract.representation: real macro observation nodes shared with RVQ; forward,left,ccw_yaw_rad
training_contract.action_coordinate_system: NWU body frame: forward, left, counter-clockwise yaw radians
training_contract.observation_sampling: exact same GT macro nodes as RVQ, including original first and terminal frames
training_contract.fit_scope: each train trajectory sums to 1; no length buckets; all real macro-node deltas; each codeword must exceed 10cm OR 10deg

micro_merge.definition: translation<=0.10m AND abs(wrapped_yaw)<=10deg; tolerances1e-8m and1e-7deg; STOP excluded

macro_single_step_errors.definition: decode each K256 code for retained real macro observations (codes[:-1]); compare body-frame forward/left displacement norm and wrapped CCW yaw error against body_delta of each retained macro-node pose pair. STOP excluded.

stop_affordance_consistency.rule: all-zero RVQ node iff pointing token is <apos_1299>

vocabulary_projection.source: accepted RVQ branch output; counts include terminal nodes

micro_thresholds.decoded_micro: translation<=0.05m AND abs_yaw<=5deg; valid predictions only, padding excluded

merge.micro_population: All QC-retained trajectories; GT original adjacent frames versus GT selected real macro-node endpoints. STOP excluded; each edge counted once.

training_contract.representation: one continuous real-image macro observation sequence with five future GT-node targets per nonterminal decision
training_contract.action_coordinate_system: NWU body frame: forward, left, counter-clockwise yaw radians
training_contract.executed_points: decoded[0] only then observe and replan
training_contract.fitting_scope: unchanged v3 dataset-fitted codebook, originally fitted from scratch on these same80475 retained train trajectories; no old external codebook

fit_metadata.initialization: from scratch, weighted random observed targets/residuals; no old codebook read
fit_metadata.weight_policy: each retained train trajectory contributes total weight 1; all its non-STOP real macro observation nodes included
fit_metadata.mask_policy: invalid future padding excluded from assignments, centroids and normalization; STOP excluded
fit_metadata.normalization: fit uses masked population std, floor1e-4; codebooks stored in physical m,m,rad; decoder scale=15 ones
fit_metadata.objective: sequential residual weighted masked squared error in normalized pose space; first waypoint yaw weight4; inference uses actual beam objective
fit_metadata.STOP: full [0,0,0] reserved by encoder and decoder override; single stage0 ordinary

current_release_provenance.K256: Newly fitted on all QC-retained train real macro edges; each trajectory total weight1; all 256 motion centers constrained non-tiny. All labels regenerated.
current_release_provenance.RVQ: Unchanged dataset-fitted v3 codebook and encoded labels copied to independent output parts. GT nodes, targets, masks, codes and decoded values unchanged; independently verified again.
current_release_provenance.GT: Same exact true first-to-terminal original observation node indices in both branches; raw videos/poses unchanged. Immutable internal GT preparation refers to previous release, explicitly; training label parts and books are independent copies.

training_contract.STOP: three layer IDs all zero; paired with <apos_1299> pointing affordance

comparable_physical_span.span_definition: mean true path length from a decision node to its last valid future node in the five-point window (clipped to the true terminal near route end); elapsed true frozen timestamp; same GT windows for both decoders
comparable_physical_span.horizon_metric_note: per-window and per-trajectory means are both reported; all branches use the same actual future macro-node target and span/time

k64.definition: All complete QC-retained train trajectories; shared actual macro nodes; open loop never reanchored; local overlapping h-node windows reanchored at each true start, each trajectory contributes its mean once. h is nodes, not seconds. Position metres; yaw degrees. Training reconstruction only.

k32.definition: All complete QC-retained train trajectories; shared actual macro nodes; open loop never reanchored; local overlapping h-node windows reanchored at each true start, each trajectory contributes its mean once. h is nodes, not seconds. Position metres; yaw degrees. Training reconstruction only.
